page_note: 该页为OECD经济展望正文页，中部为Figure 1.18（A、B两个面板的堆积柱状图，含三角形标记序列），下方有Note、Source与StatLink数据链接。

heading.title: Trade patterns are evolving with emerging markets becoming a key driver of growth
heading.subtitle: Averages of annual growth

panel_names: A. Contributions to global trade growth
B. Contributions to global current account balance
figures.source_line: Source: OECD Economic Outlook 118 database; and OECD calculations.

components.evidence: each period bar is built of seven coloured segments (North America, China, Europe, ... Rest of the World)
black triangle markers sit on top of / inside the stacked bars in both panels
legend entry "▲ World, %" drawn as a single triangle at each category position, same axis as bars
Panel B ticks run -1.5 to 1.5 and dark-red segments extend below 0.0
a bold black horizontal rule drawn across Panel B at the 0.0 tick
Panel A axis 0 to 5 "% pts"; Panel B axis -1.5 to 1.5 "% of nominal World GDP"
one legend row spanning both panels above them; no legend inside either panel
legend swatches sit between the panel titles and the plot areas
"A. Contributions to global trade growth" and "B. Contributions to global current account balance" above each panel
two panels, same stacked-bar form, same 5 periods and same 7 region series
"% pts" over Panel A axis and "% of nominal World GDP" over Panel B axis; ticks bare numbers
legend entry reads "World, %" while the bars are contributions in % pts
"% pts" printed above the top tick "5"; "% of nominal World GDP" above "1.5"
"Note: North America includes Canada, Mexico and the United States..." and "Source: OECD Economic Outlook 118 database..."
"StatLink  https://stat.link/mhq1ks" printed under the note and source lines
category ticks are multi-year spans "2001-09", "2011-14", "2022-25", not single years

new_components.name: diverging_stacked_bar
new_components.evidence: Panel B bars have segments above and below the 0.0 line within one category slot
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一柱内正负段各自从零线向两侧堆叠，段值不能用柱顶高度累减，必须分别测量正侧与负侧的累积边界。

new_components.name: marker_series_unit_differs_from_bars
new_components.evidence: "World, %" triangle is a growth rate while bars are "% pts" contributions, on one axis
new_components.why_it_matters: 三角标记与柱段共用一条刻度但含义/单位不同，读数时必须区分它是总量还是另一单位的序列。

new_components.name: legend_entries_split_over_two_panels
new_components.evidence: North America/China/Europe/South-East Asian swatches sit over Panel A, Other advanced/India/Rest of the World over Panel B
new_components.why_it_matters: 图例在版面上被两面板分割，容易被误读成各面板专属图例，从而错配颜色到序列。

new_components.name: segment_reaching_axis_bound
new_components.evidence: Panel B 2001-09 dark-red segment runs from 0.0 down to the bottom tick -1.5
new_components.why_it_matters: 该段恰抵坐标下界，无法判断是否被截断，负向读数存在下限不确定性。

difficulty_notes: 数值全部未标注，必须靠像素对刻度换算。面板A刻度间距为1 % pt，面板B为0.5，在150 dpi下1个刻度间隔约40 px，因此0.4这样的值5%容差仅±0.02，相当于不足1 px；India、Other advanced economies等薄段在面板B里只有几个像素高，-0.1的正负归属都难以确定。面板B还是零线双向堆叠，段值需要用两个累积边界相减，误差叠加后基本无法落在容差内。相比之下寻址只需“面板标题+期间+序列名”三个键，面板标题已是加粗式小标题，风险明显小于读数。
